Task: Use filter controls (e.g., dropdowns for breed, checkboxes for size) to refine the list of dogs.
Expected Result: The list of displayed dogs updates dynamically to show only those matching all selected filter criteria.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
